```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")

listings = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()

DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```

## Task 1

```{r}
host_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "host_listings")

host_counts

host_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(host_listings >= 10) |>
  dplyr::summarise(hosts_10_or_more = dplyr::n())

listings_with_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

listings_with_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    percent_10_or_more = mean(host_listings >= 10) * 100
  )


task1_city_shares = listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id") |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    listings_10_plus = sum(host_listings >= 10),
    total_listings = dplyr::n(),
    share_10_plus = listings_10_plus / total_listings * 100
  )

task1_city_shares

```

# Task 2

```{r}
task2 = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates >= 4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    price_per_person = price / accommodates
  )

task2

task2_neighbourhoods = task2 |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_price_per_person = median(price_per_person),
    listings = dplyr::n()
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(listings >= 20)

task2_neighbourhoods

task2_neighbourhoods |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::arrange(median_price_per_person)

```

# Task 3

```{r}
task3 = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

task3

task3 |>
  dplyr::filter(
    city == "Twin Cities",
    room_type == "Entire home/apt"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(city, room_type, estimated_revenue_l365d)


```

# Task 4

```{r}
task4 = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    top_10 = dplyr::row_number() <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())
  )

task4

task4 |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    top_10_revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[top_10], na.rm = TRUE),
    total_revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_top_10 = top_10_revenue / total_revenue * 100
  )


task4_city_shares = task4 |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    top_10_revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[top_10], na.rm = TRUE),
    total_revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE),
    share_top_10_revenue = top_10_revenue / total_revenue * 100
  )

task4_city_shares

```


# Task 5
```{r}
task5 = availability |>
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10") |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    listings |>
      dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt"),
    by = "id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    mostly_taken = nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month
  )

task5

task5_shares = task5 |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    share_mostly_taken = mean(mostly_taken) * 100
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(share_mostly_taken)

task5_shares

```

# Task 6

```{r}
task6 = reviews |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    listings |>
      dplyr::select(id, city),
    by = "id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    month >= "2025-07",
    month <= "2026-06"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_reviews = sum(reviews, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

task6

twin_cities_reviews = task6 |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_reviews))

twin_cities_reviews

twin_cities_reviews |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    busiest_reviews = max(total_reviews),
    quietest_reviews = min(total_reviews),
    busiest_to_quietest_ratio = busiest_reviews / quietest_reviews
  )

```


# Task 7
```{r}
task7 = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    host_is_superhost %in% c("t", "f")
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rating = median(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

task7

```

# Task 8
```{r}
task8 = listings |>
  dplyr::anti_join(
    availability,
    by = "id"
  )

task8

task8 |>
  dplyr::count(city, name = "missing_availability") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(missing_availability))
```
